items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: Mary Lou William's husband, Shorty Baker.

ctx.x: Yeah, he's a magnificent man. I just had some good reports tonight, did you tell me or somebody told me that they asked him to take a 10 piece band to Japan or some place like that.
Oh, really. That will be great. He had a trumpet player I was crazy about, too. Mary Lou William's husband, Shorty Baker.
No, he wasn't Mary Louis' husband?
